# Ultralytics YOLO26-s-seg

Instance Segmentation · `yolo26-s-seg_640x640` · DX-APP Python example

Instance Segmentation model, evaluated on COCO.

**Input** 640 × 640 × 3 · **Dataset** COCO · **License** AGPL-3.0 · **Quantization** Q-Lite, Q-Pro

![Ultralytics YOLO26-s-seg output](result.webp)

Full card with copy buttons and dark/light theme (open it in a browser; GitHub shows its source): [model.html](model.html)

## Quick start

Run from the dx_app root after `./install.sh` and `./build.sh`.

```bash
# from the dx_app root
./setup_sample_models.sh --models yolo26s-seg
```

**Python**

```bash
python src/python_example/instance_segmentation/yolo26_seg/yolo26-s-seg_640x640/yolo26-s-seg_640x640_sync.py \
  --model assets/models/yolo26-s-seg_640x640.dxnn \
  --image sample/img/sample_street.jpg
```

**C++**

```bash
./build.sh --target yolo26-s-seg_640x640_sync   # once
./bin/yolo26-s-seg_640x640_sync \
  -m assets/models/yolo26-s-seg_640x640.dxnn \
  -i sample/img/sample_street.jpg
```

## Performance

**141 FPS** and **91.2 FPS/W** on DX-M1, DX Model Zoo reference measurement (publish table, 2026-10-13).

### Accuracy

| Quantization | mAP |
|---|---:|
| Raw · ONNX | 35.62 |
| Q-Lite | 35.03 (−0.59) |
| Q-Pro | 34.93 (−0.69) |

COCO · difference vs Raw in brackets.

### Measured on host boards

| Board | Throughput FPS | Single-stream FPS | Latency ms |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| DX-H1 Quattro · BIOSTAR | 575.8 | 38.4 | 26.0 |
| DX-M1 · AIPlayer N97 | 138.2 | 22.1 | 45.2 |
| DX-M1 · Orange Pi 5+ | 140.0 | 18.6 | 53.7 |
| DX-M1 · ROCK 5B+ | 139.0 | 22.2 | 45.0 |
| DX-M1 · Raspberry Pi 5 | 95.7 | 22.9 | 43.6 |
| DX-M1M · Raspberry Pi 5 | 94.8 | 21.5 | 46.5 |

DX AI Studio Benchmark, July 2026, DX-RT without ORT. Throughput: 5 in-flight buffers. Single-stream: 1.
